build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search params
build_task_world: build a physics world with build_task that creates a container, floor, and dynamic ball
add_container_shape: add a container shape to the scene using vt.add_container with polygon coordinates
add_box_floor: add a box floor to the scene using vt.add_box with width and height dimensions
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the scene using C.add with radius and center coordinates
